completed_calls:
web_fetch (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2324.html):
RFC 2324, published 1 April 1998, defines HTTP 418 status code with reason phrase 'I'm a teapot'. Section 2.3.2 states: "Any attempt to brew coffee with a teapot should result in the error code \"418 I'm a teapot\". The resulting entity body MAY be short and stout." The document title is "Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol (HTCPCP/1.0)" by L. Masinter, Category: Informational.
